docs.title: HomeTiles v0.6.7
docs.text: HomeTiles v0.6.7 adds local access control for Settings and folders and improves display and screensaver stability.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Added optional 4–8 digit PIN protection for Settings and individual folders.
  • Settings can be parked outside the Home grid and reopened with a configurable inward edge swipe while preserving the tile title, icon, color, size, and position.
  • Added a shared localized PIN keypad with masked input, recovery PIN support, automatic timeout, and immediate protected-folder navigation.
  • Improved Guition ESP32-S3 display synchronization while saving configuration and moving the Settings tile.
  • Avoided blocking SD-card mount retries when a screensaver starts without a card and accelerated the black ESP32-P4 fallback frame.
  • Corrected ESP32-P4 detection and module-cache refreshes in the browser installer.

docs.title: Update Notes
docs.text:
HomeTiles Bridge v0.6.37 is the current recommended companion release. The new PIN controls are local to the display and do not require a new Bridge protocol.

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional factory reset.

The PIN feature is a local child lock, not an authenticated login. Anyone with Web Admin access can manage and reveal the configured PINs. The documented Factory PIN can unlock Settings and protected folders.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.6.8
docs.text: HomeTiles v0.6.8 expands hardware coverage and improves ESP32-P4 Camera and display stability.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Added release and browser-installer coverage for Waveshare 7B/7B-C, Guition JC1060P470C V2, and Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4B.
  • Added two explicit Waveshare 7B/7B-C release and browser-installer entries: ESP32-P4 before v3.0 (revisions 1–199), and exact ESP32-P4 v3.1. The v3.1 entry is experimental and exact hardware has not been verified.
  • Fixed Waveshare 7B startup by avoiding the EK79007 display-on/off operation that its panel driver does not support.
  • Stabilized Camera presentation across native ESP32-P4 DSI profiles with protected double buffering and fail-closed handling when PPA or display refresh completion is missing.
  • Added a persistent display-pipeline timeout report before a controlled restart, because that safe restart does not create a normal core dump.
  • A missing Camera response now reports MQTT or Bridge reachability instead of incorrectly claiming that HomeTiles Bridge is outdated.
  • Corrected the hardware-reported default orientation on Waveshare 10.1-inch and Guition JC1060 V2, added a readable 2% brightness floor on the 10.1-inch, and corrected the JC1060 V2 LCD-reset/GPIO mapping.

docs.title: Update Notes
docs.text:
HomeTiles Bridge v0.6.37 remains the recommended companion release. No new Bridge protocol is required for these changes.

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional factory reset.

For Waveshare 7B/7B-C, select ESP32-P4 before v3.0 (revisions 1–199) or exact ESP32-P4 v3.1 (experimental) in the browser installer. That selection determines the asset. The browser installer, Web Admin upload, and on-device OTA updater enforce the revision contract and reject mismatches. The base filename is for revisions 1–199; _rev3_1 is only for exact v3.1 (301).

The other current ESP32-P4 profiles use vendor-listed P4NRW32/pre-v3 modules and are also explicitly guarded to revisions 1–199. ESP32-P4 v3.2 or newer is unsupported with Arduino-ESP32 3.3.7 / ESP-IDF 5.5.2 and must not be flashed. Direct esptool flashing of the v3.1 image to v3.2+ is unsafe because the Arduino v3.00 or newer build's underlying ESP header can span revisions 301–399 and bypass HomeTiles' exact-v3.1 check.

Saved display orientations remain unchanged. The corrected orientation defaults apply when no orientation has been saved yet.

docs.title: Hardware Confirmed
docs.text:
A short Camera smoke test passed on M5Stack Tab5, Waveshare 4B, and Waveshare Touch LCD 8-inch. This was not a long-duration stress test.

Waveshare 10.1-inch display operation, Wi-Fi, MQTT, and OTA were independently reported working before this release's orientation and brightness-default corrections. A JC1060 V2 tester reported that everything worked apart from the previous 180-degree default. The Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-4B implementation also received an initial real-hardware confirmation.

docs.title: Pending Hardware Validation
docs.text:
The Camera fix still needs exact-device confirmation on the Guition JC8012 V1 reported in issue #30 and on the other unowned native DSI profiles. The 7B pre-v3 path and especially the experimental exact-v3.1 path still need physical startup, display, touch, storage, networking, Camera, and OTA confirmation. The corrected JC1060 V2 and Waveshare 10.1-inch defaults and the first published Waveshare ESP32-S3 4B release/OTA path also need confirmation. CI compilation is not treated as physical validation.

Thanks to @pguns for the Camera crash report, @mccarron for the Waveshare 7B startup log, @atliant for the Waveshare 10.1-inch report, @hromych for JC1060 V2 testing, and @ehfortin and @exiom-xyz for Waveshare ESP32-S3 4B support and hardware feedback.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.6.9
docs.text: HomeTiles v0.6.9 adds state-aware Binary Sensor tiles and categorical Sensor history, expands hardware coverage, and improves display stability and brightness handling.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Added a dedicated Binary Sensor tile for Home Assistant binary_sensor.* entities, including localized device-class states, state-dependent Home Assistant icons, availability handling, folders, screensaver slots, live Web Admin previews, and autosave.
  • Added a responsive 24-hour and 7-day state timeline with a scrollable, date-grouped Activity list. Text-valued sensor.* entities use the same categorical history view, while numeric Sensor entities retain their chart.
  • Added release and browser-installer support for the Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4.3. Its core display, touch, networking, Web Admin, tile persistence, MQTT, Home Assistant discovery, and Weather paths have been confirmed on ESP32-P4 v1.3 hardware.
  • Prevented thin, full-width Activity-list redraw strips on the Waveshare 8-inch display from entering the PPA rotation path that could time out and trigger a controlled restart.
  • Corrected Waveshare 4B brightness scaling so normal display, screensaver, and Home Assistant controls expose the complete visible 1–100 % range. Raw zero remains reserved for internal sleep and restart blanking.
  • Improved ESP32-S3 popup refresh and rendering work bounds, coalesced redundant Light updates, and kept Weather parsing incremental during active UI work.
  • Strengthened Web Admin accessibility, escaping, autosave behavior, and regression coverage while centralizing additional UI translations.

docs.title: Update Notes
docs.text:
HomeTiles Bridge v0.6.40 is the recommended companion release and is required for Binary Sensor and categorical Sensor history. Bridge v0.6.40 remains compatible with older HomeTiles firmware and configurations.

Update the Bridge through HACS and restart Home Assistant before relying on the new history views. Existing tile layouts remain compatible; Binary Sensor uses a newly appended stable tile type and does not renumber existing types.

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional factory reset.

Camera support remains experimental and is available only on ESP32-P4 targets. This release does not classify Camera as generally stable, and the unresolved Guition JC8012 V1 transport investigation remains separate from the new Sensor work.

For Waveshare 7B/7B-C, continue to select the image matching the exact silicon revision. The base image is for pre-v3 revisions 1–199; _rev3_1 is only for exact ESP32-P4 v3.1. ESP32-P4 v3.2 or newer remains unsupported with the pinned toolchain and must not be flashed.

docs.title: Hardware Confirmed
docs.text:
The new Sensor and Binary Sensor UI paths were exercised on Waveshare 4B, Waveshare Touch LCD 8-inch, and Guition ESP32-4848S040 ESP32-S3 hardware.

Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4.3 hardware confirms display, touch, Wi-Fi, Web Admin, tile persistence, MQTT, Home Assistant discovery, and Weather.

docs.title: Pending Hardware Validation
docs.text:
Camera remains experimental across ESP32-P4 devices. The Guition JC8012 V1 network-transport investigation and the existing validation gaps for unowned device revisions remain open.

Waveshare 4.3-inch microSD and OTA operation still need physical validation. The Waveshare 8-inch thin-redraw guard and the complete Waveshare 4B brightness curve should continue to receive field feedback after release. CI compilation is not treated as physical validation.

Thanks to @schjonhaug for the Waveshare 4.3-inch implementation and hardware feedback.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.7.0
docs.text: v0.7.0 adds half-size tiles, color rules and built-in cameras for Home Assistant.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Tiles can be placed and resized in half steps, and many tile types can be half height.
  • Corner radius, icon circles and tile colors are adjustable. With rules, icon and tile change color by value or state, take the entity's own color, or follow another entity.
  • ESP32-P4 displays with a camera can share it with Home Assistant. The camera is off by default and remains experimental.
  • Sensor and Energy graphs show the value under your finger. Climate shows all fan and swing modes that Home Assistant provides.
  • Folders stay fast after long uptime, because processed updates now release their memory.
  • New profiles for the Guition JC4880P443 (portrait) and for Waveshare 10.1 boards with ESP32-P4 v3.1 or newer.
  • Fixes for Guition V2 touch and SD card, Tab5 wake brightness, the Wi-Fi list and the screensaver image list.

docs.title: Update Notes
docs.text:
Update to HomeTiles Bridge v0.7.0 first and export your dashboard in Web Admin under Import / Export before updating.

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional reset. Select the exact board and revision.

S3 displays can fail to update through the device from v0.6.12 or from the first v0.7.0 build. Install the regular .bin once through Web Admin; later device updates use the corrected updater.

To go back to v0.6.x, make every tile whole-size first, see Going back to v0.6.x.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.8.0
docs.text: v0.8.0 polishes HomeTiles throughout: smoother operation, a refined design and many bug fixes. It also adds Lock, Alarm Panel and Fan tiles, a Web Admin password with encrypted commands, a redesigned Switch tile, and French and Polish.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• New Lock, Alarm Panel and Fan tiles (#21, #49, #50). Locks and alarm panels need encrypted commands and a Web Admin password.
  • An optional Web Admin password protects the Web Admin. Commands to the Bridge can be encrypted; pairing compares a six-digit number.
  • The Switch tile has a dimmer or switch bar, and sliders send their commands like Home Assistant (#11). Cover and Climate tiles got new layouts, and almost every tile can be half height.
  • French and Polish, with their letters on the keyboard. Polish translation by @majki09 (#51).
  • Faster everywhere: LVGL 9.6, about 300 KB less flash, more free RAM, quicker popups and screensaver, and Web Admin edits that show on the display almost at once.
  • A polished Web Admin: dragging tiles is much faster, the preview now matches the display exactly, and many fixes.
  • Camera popups at up to 30 FPS, smoother auto exposure for built-in cameras (#67), and no more blue flash on ESP32-P4 displays while saving.
  • Colored weather icons with night icons, and 7-day graphs that load much faster with Bridge v0.8.0.
  • New images for the Guition JC8012P4A1 V3 (#44) and the Waveshare 7B with ESP32-P4 v3.x (#41).
  • An updated browser installer that also flashes ESP32-P4 v3.x boards and restarts every board after flashing (#57).
  • Many fixes and polish, including the S3-Touch-LCD-4B image shift (#26), Guition V2 microSD restarts (#55), old Media covers (#16), a dashboard import that stopped halfway (#70) and camera images on 1024×600 panels (#63).

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional reset. Select the exact board and revision.

Waveshare 7B panels running the former v3.1-only image need one browser installer Update with the new 7B v3 image.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.9.0
docs.text: v0.9.0 connects panels to the Bridge directly without MQTT and adds head bar layouts with pages, an upright mode, a light theme, and a new Settings screen with a first-start setup on the panel.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Direct link to the Bridge: press Pair on the panel and add it in Home Assistant. No MQTT broker is needed; existing MQTT setups keep working.
  • Layouts: the new head bar layout shows fewer, larger tiles under a head with title, time and gear. ESP32-P4 panels mounted upright get their own upright layout. The Web Admin's layout window keeps separate places for every layout.
  • Pages: up to five folders become pages beside Home. Dots in the head show the page; swipe or tap beside the dots to turn it, or open the overview.
  • Light theme: Dark, Light or Automatic (light by day, dark by night), on the panel and in the Web Admin.
  • New Settings on the panel with Wi-Fi list, keyboard with accents and French AZERTY, and a first-start setup in four steps.
  • Entity picker like in Home Assistant: search every entity through the Bridge, with Recent and Favorites on top (#79).
  • Clock tile: analog and wall clock styles, weekday and more date formats, rolling digits (#13). The Text tile has nine alignments, half height and a transparent style.
  • Cameras: full screen on every ESP32-P4 panel at up to 30 FPS (#65), camera streams on the ESP32-S3 panels, camera tiles that show the picture (#50), and the screensaver can show a Home Assistant camera or image (#69). A View select option opens a camera straight in full screen, for example for a doorbell.
  • Simpler colors: a tile's color always comes from its icon, with one Fill option; color rules can fill a tile too.
  • Edge swipes for Settings, Home, Back and the screensaver.
  • The Weather tile can show its own temperature and humidity sensors, in the weather entity's unit (#85, #86 by @derhally).
  • Faster popups, folders and screensaver, and many fixes, including the Safari selection ring (#80), gauge decimals (#83) and the view catalog language (#72).

docs.title: Update Notes
docs.text:
Update to HomeTiles Bridge v0.9.0 first and export your dashboard in Web Admin under Import / Export before updating.

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional reset. Select the exact board and revision.

Going back to v0.8.0: v0.8.0 only knows the classic layout. Before downgrading, open the layout window, switch to Classic, make sure no tile is red, and save. Panels mounted upright show the classic landscape layout on v0.8.0. v0.8.0 needs MQTT; a panel on the direct link must be added in Home Assistant over MQTT again. Updating to v0.9.0 again restores every layout, page and place. See Going back to v0.8.0.

docs.text: The maintainer tested this release on M5Stack Tab5, Waveshare LCD-4B and LCD-8, Guition JC8012P4A1 V2 and Guition ESP32-4848S040 (S3), including the direct link, head bar layouts, pages and the light theme. Built-in cameras were tested on Guition V2 and Tab5. A downgrade to v0.8.0 and the update back were tested on the Waveshare LCD-8.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.9.1
docs.text: v0.9.1 moves the Material Design icons into a file on the panel, which frees room in the firmware, and applies the entity rule to energy data.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• More room in the firmware: all 7447 Material Design icons now live in a file on the panel. The M5Stack Tab5 image shrinks from 6.8 MB to 4.8 MB. The 399 most used icons stay built in, including Home Assistant's default icons.
  • Energy tile: the picker finds the sources of the Home Assistant Energy dashboard through the Bridge. A tile shows its source's icon by itself.
  • Energy data only as released: without a Web Admin password a panel gets only the categories enabled under Energy Dashboard in the Bridge options, like every other entity.
  • The Web Admin follows a Web Admin password that is set or removed on the panel.
  • No more scroll bars around the preview at 125 % display scaling.

docs.title: Update Notes
docs.text:
Update to HomeTiles Bridge v0.9.1 first. On a panel without a Web Admin password, enable the Energy Dashboard categories you use in the Bridge options; otherwise its Energy tiles stay empty.

After the update each panel downloads its icon file once from this release (1.3 to 2 MB) and restarts once. It needs internet access to GitHub for this. Without it, the panel shows the built-in icons and a placeholder for the others, and tries again on the next restarts.

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional reset. Select the exact board and revision.

Going back to v0.9.0 works. The icon file stays on the panel and is used again after the next update.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.9.2
docs.text: v0.9.2 mainly fixes bugs and brings an early version of the voice assistant to the ESP32-P4 panels.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Direct link: a panel no longer drops its connection to the Bridge every 45 seconds while Home Assistant has nothing to send.
  • Button tile (formerly Scene): its picker finds every scene, script and button through the Bridge, like the other tiles; before, it listed only the ones released in the Bridge options (#106). Existing tiles keep working.
  • Guition JC1060P470C V2: Rotation 0 and 180 work again (#108).
  • Folders: tiles kept in a layout's storage no longer take the folder's free cells. On the Waveshare LCD-4B a free cell of the head bar layout could not take a new tile. The storage now has its own room. A full storage blocks Save in the layout window with a note, and a full folder says so when you click a free cell.
  • Logs name the way the panel talks to Home Assistant (Link or MQTT) correctly.
  • Voice assistant, early version: ESP32-P4 panels with a speaker and microphone play audio from Home Assistant and work as an Assist satellite, also with a wake word (Okay Nabu, Hey Jarvis, Alexa). It is set up in Home Assistant; the panel has no microphone button and no audio settings yet. See Voice assistant.

Use the regular .bin for OTA or the browser installer's Update mode. Use _factory.bin only for a first installation or an intentional reset. Select the exact board and revision.

Going back to v0.9.1: Button tiles picked with v0.9.2 and tiles in a folder's storage beyond its cells are unknown to v0.9.1. Export your dashboard in Web Admin under Import / Export before going back.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.9.3
docs.text: v0.9.3 adds Czech, Slovak and Spanish, shows the icon file on the System page and adds two new displays.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• New languages: Czech, Slovak and Spanish. Choose them under Localization on the display or in the Web Admin.
  • Keyboard: every language brings its own letters to the accent key, and holding a letter offers its accented forms with the language's own first. Czech and Slovak type on QWERTZ; Spanish has ñ, ¿ and ¡.
  • Long dates follow the language, also with the year: "21 de agosto de 2026" in Spanish, "21. srpna 2026" in Czech.
  • Icons card on the Web Admin System page: it shows whether the icon file with all 7447 icons is on the display, links the right file for the display, downloads it with Update, and installs a file uploaded by hand for networks that block the display's own download (#112). Factory images now contain the icon file, so a freshly flashed display shows every icon at once.
  • New displays, not tested on hardware yet: Golden Security GS-T3E v2 (#93) and Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-5 (#76), the 5-inch with the voice assistant and the optional OV5647 camera.

docs.title: Update Notes

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.9.4
docs.text: v0.9.4 rebuilds the media player popup, turns the display's speaker into a small player and lets Home Assistant set the theme and the rotation.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Media popup: two layouts per tile (cover on the left or in the middle), and only the controls the player offers in Home Assistant. Shuffle and repeat show in the icon's color with a dot when they are on. The time bar follows the position Home Assistant reports and no longer jumps back when the volume changes.
  • A menu in the popup's corner opens the player's Speakers (play on several speakers together), its Source and its Library to browse and play media. The library keeps its place until the popup closes. The speakers tab shows how many players play together.
  • Media tile: the icon shows whether the player plays, pauses or is off, and the playing bars from the popup stand over the title.
  • Speaker on ESP32-P4 displays with voice (experimental): it plays every format Home Assistant sends (the Bridge decodes it), with title, position, pause and seeking in Home Assistant. A camera stream with sound plays its sound in the camera popup and full screen, in step with the picture (experimental, like camera streaming itself). On these displays Settings → Display & Sound has a Sound group with volume and a microphone switch (#123). On a new display the microphone and wake word listening start switched off.
  • Home Assistant: the display's device page has a Theme select (Dark, Light, Automatic) and a Display Rotation select with the steps the display offers (0°, 90°, 180°, 270° on displays that turn in quarter turns, 0° and 180° on the others).
  • Add a display to Home Assistant by its IP address where mDNS does not reach it (#114).
  • Web Admin: a + on a free page field makes a new page (#100), and a deleted folder leaves the display and its page at once. The export contains the Settings tile, the import shows its progress to the end, and the display always starts with the chosen layout.
  • Fixes: units with "µ" show the micro sign (#115); ESP32-P4 displays give each Wi-Fi join 30 s and retry 5 s after a failed one (#120); MP3 clips that crashed the speaker play or are skipped (#119); the Waveshare 7B v3 runs its Wi-Fi link at 20 MHz and restarts cleanly; lists in the first-start setup scroll by touch (#41); the GS-T3E keeps all three relays (#93).

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.9.6
docs.text: v0.9.6 adds the Calendar and Power flow tiles, graphs on Sensor and Energy tiles, new Sensor looks, Russian as the eighth language and faster drawing on every display.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Calendar tile (#84): agenda, countdown, week and month views and a calendar popup with a month view and a list of the coming four weeks. Several calendars in one tile, each with its own color.
  • Power flow tile: solar, grid, battery and home power as nodes with moving dots that follow the power's direction and size. The battery shows its charge and whether it charges; tap a node for its sensor popup.
  • Sensor graph (#131): the area under the line fades from the icon's color, the tile shows the last 24 hours and the popup has the ranges 30D, 7D, 24H, 6H and 1H. Touch the graph to read an earlier value.
  • Energy popup: Year, Month, Week and Today, each from its start up to now, with bars in the icon's color. The Energy tile can show today's hours as bars (Display mode: Graph). Web Admin → Localization → First day of the week sets where a week starts for Energy, the Calendar and the 30D graph lines.
  • Sensor tile looks: the value alone, a bar or a ring, each filled, as a line or striped, open or closed, with the value on top or inside. The editor opens them in a menu like the Switch tile's.
  • Rules can change the icon (#102): every color in a rule can bring its own icon, and the tile's own icon comes back when the rule ends.
  • Switch and Fan tiles can stand their bar upright (Orientation: Upright).
  • Lights (#130): the Home Assistant color in the dark and the light theme, and Fill also fills white and near-white light. A Switch tile keeps the level set in the Light popup while Home Assistant answers.
  • Russian: all texts, Cyrillic in every text size and a ЙЦУКЕН keyboard whose ABC key switches to QWERTY for passwords.
  • Units stand a step smaller after their number, like in the weather forecast, on tiles, in popups and in state lines. The weather tile fits one more forecast day.
  • Faster: fonts unpack each character once, rounded corners and shadows come from kept masks, page turns skip tiles that did not change, the pages overview redraws only its card, and the Guition JC8012P4A1 V2 copies a finished part of the screen while the next one is drawn. Popups open in their tile's colors from the first frame.
  • Guition JC8012P4A1 V1 and V2: a resting finger holds still and a slow drag stays close to the finger; a lifting finger no longer moves a slider at the last moment.
  • Web Admin: value size lists name the sizes the display really draws, and the head bar page dots follow the preview's theme.
  • New image: the Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-4.3 with ESP32-P4 v3.1 or newer (experimental, #135). Check the revision with esptool chip-id and choose Waveshare Touch LCD 4.3 inch (ESP32-P4 v3.1 or newer, experimental) in the browser installer.

docs.title: HomeTiles v0.9.7
docs.text: v0.9.7 adds the Vacuum tile, keeps the Energy tile's bars current during the hour and brings an image for the Waveshare 8-inch with ESP32-P4 v3.

docs.title: Highlights
docs.text:
• Vacuum tile (#50): the state and battery, and buttons by the tile's width: Clean (Pause while cleaning) on one column, Clean and Dock on two, Clean, Stop and Dock from three. From two by two the tile shows the vacuum's map with its state, battery and cleaned area beside it. Only the buttons the vacuum supports are active.
  • Vacuum popup: the map (left or centred), cleaned area, cleaning time and battery, Clean, Stop and Dock, and a menu with the suction power, the rooms to clean and Locate.
  • The vacuum's map comes from the image or camera entity of its device, or the one you choose in the tile; a camera map refreshes at the tile's Refresh (s). The map is fetched from the start and shows at once in the tile and the popup.
  • Energy tile bars and today's total follow the running hour instead of standing still until the next full hour (with HomeTiles Bridge v0.9.7).
  • Sensor popup (#139): the graph opens with the newest point as a dot in the line's color; the cursor line appears once you touch the graph.
  • Button tile (#138): buttons with long entity ids work; the picker keeps the full entity id.
  • New image: the Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-Touch-LCD-8 with ESP32-P4 v3.1 or newer (experimental, #140). Check the revision with esptool chip-id and choose Waveshare Touch LCD 8 inch (ESP32-P4 v3.1 or newer, experimental) in the browser installer.
